newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to hold Gulf of Mexico lease sale March 5.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to hold Gulf of Mexico lease sale March 5.

text.p: The U.S. Minerals Management Service confirmed Friday that it would hold its Central Gulf of Mexico oil and natural gas lease sale 166 on March 5 in New Orleans, Louisiana.

In its final notice of sale, the agency said it would offer 5,063 blocks covering about 27 million acres in the Central Gulf of Mexico outer continental shelf area off Louisiana, Mississippi, and Alabama.
The blocks are in water three to 200 miles offshore in depths ranging from four to more than 3,425 meters.
Almost 4,000 of the blocks are in water depths of 200 meters or more, where leases would be eligible for royalty relief under a law passed in 1995, MMS said.

"I don't know if this sale will be a record-setter like Sale 157 (last year), but I am confident that there will be considerable industry interest and that the coffers of the U.S. Treasury will be fuller as a result," said MMS Director Cynthia Quarterman.
